historical_execution_source.immutability: A1 and A2 remain FAIL; a later composite replay is a separate receipt and never rewrites either status.

execution_requirements.stats_on_simulator_policy: reuse one immutable ARCH_STABLE frozen executable for all six runs
execution_requirements.ordering: all original executions were sequential under one Windows-to-WSL shell owner

composite_replay_requirements.original_status: A1 and A2 status files must remain exact FAIL receipts
composite_replay_requirements.original_execution: A2 preflight, six stats-on runs, one stats-off build, two stats-off runs and manifest creation must all be rc=0
composite_replay_requirements.original_cleanup: A2 cleanup_rc must be 0 and the reproducible stats-off build tree must have been deleted
composite_replay_requirements.known_original_failure: A2 audit_rc=1 is retained as the phase-alignment oracle rejection; original postflight_rc and verify_rc remain 1/not-run
composite_replay_requirements.checker_replay: a new manifest must bind the frozen A2 artifacts, this v2 contract and its amendment; build and canonical verify must both return 0
composite_replay_requirements.fresh_postflight: ARCH_STABLE must be freshly verified after checker replay and its exact output artifact must be bound into the composite receipt
composite_replay_requirements.publication: PERF_BASELINE current may be published only from the canonical composite receipt after every requirement above passes

acceptance.stats_on: each raw log independently passes v8 FINAL and v4 COUNTERS_FINAL parsing plus the bound endpoint qualification amendment
acceptance.repeatability: cycles, retired instructions, complete counter stack and endpoint-corrected two-lane ledger are bit-exact across three repetitions
acceptance.instrumentation_non_interference: stats-off cycles and retired instructions exactly match the stats-on baseline for both workloads
acceptance.identity: all artifacts bind repository-relative path, byte size and SHA-256
acceptance.postflight: fresh ARCH_STABLE verify output is mandatory in the composite receipt

not_claimed: global integer and FP physical issue-slot capacity

refresh_triggers: simulator executable or host harness semantic change
config, workload image, ROI marker, counter schema, measurement contract, amendment, policy or checker change
memory or device latency semantic change
any historical source status, command status, manifest or frozen artifact drift
